title: Remboy optimized
description: The focusing purely of the modpack is to increase FPS 4x higher (which gives you maximum performance), vanilla visual improvements.
body:
![It is about the title of the modpack and a word that says (Top optimization).](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dfcc448d326e6ec30db6ad1687eebbd220973ebf.png)

### What is it about:
It is a modpack that gives an FPS improvement of about x4 (400%), therefore it provides maximum performance and includes animations that enhance the player experience without consuming almost any performance.

### 📊Performance:                                                                                        
**Test**       |      **Avg FPS**    |   **Min FPS**   |    **Max FPS**                            
:---      |  :---        |    :---   |   :---                        
Remboy optimized   |   340            |       256            |360
Vanilla            |    147               |   117            |168

##### Tested on 12 chunks render and 5 shadow distance. With Intel graphics, Intel i5 210H.On more powerful PCs they achieve 4x or even 6x.

### Main features:
#### Maximum performance:
Select the mods that give you the maximum possible performance and are configured. Reducing RAM usage and stutters on all types of devices.
#### Extremely lightweight:
Since it only includes optimization mods and vanilla visual enhancements that hardly consume any performance. Downloading it doesn't take up much space.
#### It works on all types of platforms:
By only including optimization mods and vanilla visual improvements that consume almost no performance, it allows you to use it in worlds and servers with ease because it does not bring content that alters the game and it remains vanilla.
#### 🌍Continuous updates:
Our purpose is to improve your FPS and give you vanilla visual enhancements (it hardly affects performance), which allows us to make updates more continuously.
### Recommendation:
Now that you know everything about the modpack, we would recommend that you [install the modpack.](https://modrinth.com/modpack/remboy-optimized/versions)
### ✅Installation guide:
- Download the Modrinth app with the browser or other launchers that allow the installation of Modrinth modpacks.
- Install the Remboy Optimized modpack in "browser" in the Modrinth app.
- **¡Open the game** and enjoy a smoother experience and vanilla visual improvements! (they barely consume performance).
